title: Chapter 37: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression
content:
Chapter 37: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression

When the first rays of morning light shone on the earth, the people sleeping on the ground outside the Great Xia Territory got up and prepared to start a new day of work.

The sooner the residential area is built, the sooner everyone can have a place to live.

Today, everyone can go to collect food first, which is considered an advance payment of wages. Yesterday's work wages were deducted by the lord, and a bunch of daily necessities were issued as welfare.

This is the first time that everyone has encountered the management mode of the Great Xia Territory, which is like a chamber of commerce, paying according to work and settling accounts on a daily basis.

Unlike the traditional territory management method, this management method is very friendly to the people. As long as they are willing to work hard, they will have room to survive.

In other words, as long as the Great Xia Territory is still there, everyone can live well.

So everyone is full of energy.

After breakfast, everyone happily joined the army of building the new city of the Great Xia Territory.

…

At this time, the puppy in the territory closest to the city of the bear goblins had run to the surveillance position to monitor the movements of the bear goblins.

Yesterday, the scouts brought back intelligence about the territories of the native races. If nothing unexpected happens, the bear goblins will definitely take action.

Wu Qing has already dispatched 3,000 puppies and 400 hydralisks to the possible areas of battle.

In the Zerg territory, all energy resources are used to produce puppies first.

As expected, after breakfast, the lizardmen army began to leave the city of the bear goblins.

These lizardmen troops were divided into three teams, each with more than 3,000 troops. Under the leadership of the scouts, they went straight to their respective targets.

At the same time, a large number of elite bear goblin scouts scattered and conducted a carpet reconnaissance of the area.

"The bear goblins should have noticed the existence of the Zerg."

"Do they want to get rid of the unstable factor of the Zerg before the decisive battle?"

"Are the tens of thousands of lizardmen sent out a bait?"

Wu Qing saw the action deployment of the bear goblins and had some guesses.

The mysterious disappearance of an elite force of bear goblins led by a priest, together with the disappearance of the pursuit force and the lizardman interception force, is enough to prove that in addition to the main force of the Tengu clan, there is another strong force active in this area.

The bear goblins and the Tengu clans fought a great battle, and the intelligence capabilities of both sides must be strong and they know each other very well. The Zerg troops led by Wu Qing are unexpected variables.

They should have noticed it.

Wu Qing and the Zerg's high-profile behavior of fighting whenever there is a war, the enemy can't help but want to know his existence.

"However, there is no reason not to eat the meat that is delivered to your mouth?"

"The Zerg has never been judged by common sense. Your self-proclaimed clever means are equivalent to the lowest level of mistakes in the Zerg!"

Wu Qing deduced their target territory based on the direction of advance of the three Lizardman armies, and sent the Zerg army to ambush in front of the most threatening Lizardman army.

As for the roaming scouts of the bugbear tribe, they were allowed to move freely. Only those who had an impact on the Zerg's movements were sent to besiege and kill by the puppies.

No matter how elite the scouts were, they could not withstand the siege of a few puppies without star-level strength.

To ambush the lizardmen army, the hydralisk was the key. As long as 400 hydralisks were placed in the right position, plus 3,000 puppies, the 3,000-strong lizardmen army could be wiped out in a very short time.

Because of Wu Qing's advance deployment, the Zerg troops quickly arrived at the ambush site, drilled underground, and entered a perfect ambush state.

On a rare plain among the rolling hills, a tall lizardman knight led more than 3,000 lizardmen soldiers and marched quickly under the leadership of the bugbear scouts.

There were scouts all over the surrounding area, and the terrain was flat and the vision was good. The surrounding situation could be seen at a glance, and the probability of hiding enemies here was very small.

The Lizard Knight, knowing the purpose of this mission, had been on high alert to guard against the enemy in the dark. He knew that it was impossible to hide a large number of enemy troops in this environment, so he was inevitably a little lax.

The soldiers of the entire Lizard Army had this idea, which made the army look a little lazy.

Just as the Lizard Army marched to the center of the small plain, a group of terrifying alien insects over three meters high suddenly emerged from the ground not far from them and spit terrible spikes at them.

The whistling spikes were enough to penetrate gold and split stones. The Lizardmen, who were not wearing armor and only relied on their own scales for protection, could not resist such an attack at all.

The volleys on the plain terrain were like cutting wheat, sweeping a large area.

With just one volley, hundreds of Lizardmen fell down.

"Enemy attack! Enemy attack!"

"Enemy long-range attack unit! Go up and fight in close combat!"

The tall Lizard Knight reacted immediately and ordered loudly.

At the same time, he took out a firecracker-like object from his arms, pointed it in the direction of the bugbear city, and a dazzling light accompanied by a piercing scream rushed into the sky.

This thing is a signal flare from this world, made by a special method.

Even though the sun is shining brightly now, the trajectory of this signal flare is clearly visible.

Wu Qing found that the bugbear city and the other two lizardmen armies had reacted.

A large number of troops swarmed out of the bugbear city again, and the two lizardmen armies gave up their original goals and rushed towards the direction of the signal.

"You are really here to encircle and suppress me. It's a pity that you don't know anything about the Zerg."

Wu Qing was not in a hurry. It would take time for these troops to rush over, especially the troops coming out of the bugbear city. It would take a lot of time just to get out of the city.

He began to use the resources that had increased rapidly since the battle began to attack the troops. This time, he attacked all the puppies because the puppies moved faster.

To beat the enemy's time gap and engage in mobile warfare, speed is very important.

On the battlefield on the plains, the Hydralisks launched an ambush attack and fired three volleys before the Lizardmen army launched an effective charge.

After three volleys, nearly a thousand lizard soldiers fell. This was a terrifying attrition rate.

According to the optimistic estimate of the lizardman knight, if the lizardman soldiers rushed in front of the Hydralisk, it would be good if there were only a thousand people left.

He actually didn't feel confident about fighting the tall Hydralisk in close combat, but he had no choice. If he didn't do this, he would face a quick long-range massacre.

Unfortunately, his prediction was also wrong. The lizardman soldiers could not rush in front of the Hydralisk at all.

When the lizardmen soldiers paid a heavy price and were about to rush in front of the Hydralisk, densely packed puppies emerged from the ground and immediately overwhelmed the surviving lizardman soldiers.

The Lizard Knight, who was extremely powerful, could not hold on for more than a few breaths before he collapsed and disappeared in front of such a sea of insects.

The Zerg destroyed a total of 4/10 one-star creatures.
